Employee dashboard welcomes Emily and offers Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, My Profile, Request leave, Fill timesheet, and Log out. Leave balance was still loading and pending leave requests showed 0.
My profile displays editable full name, phone, and emergency contact; email is disabled. It also offers Upload photo and Save changes.
My leave offers New request, shows an available balance of 18 days, and lists an approved Vacation request for Aug 18–19, 2026 with 3 days and manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.
New leave request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal types; required start and end date fields; an optional reason; Submit request; and Cancel. It states that weekends are not counted toward leave.
Vacation is selected and the leave request form is ready to submit one future weekday of clearly marked evaluation data.
Submitting with blank start and end dates stayed on New leave request and displayed “Please fill in all required fields.” The evaluation reason remained entered; no leave request was created.
Timesheet shows a draft for week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday–Sunday hour inputs at 0, total 0 h, Save draft, and Submit week.
The Sep 14 draft is empty and Save draft is available; a one-hour evaluation-data draft will be saved.
Saving one Monday hour as evaluation data kept the week in draft status, showed total 1 h, and displayed “Draft saved.”
